The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Zal Artha''' was a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who graduated from the [[Rengali Imperial Naval Academy]]. She defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after viewing the Empire as tyrannical government and was one of two survivors of the [[Soaring Dactillions]] following the [[assault on Cardooine]]. She then requested to join [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]].<ref name="AoR" />

{{Char-stub}}
